title: Spherical harmonics with maximal Lp norm growth
summary: In this paper, we show that for every p>2, there is an orthonormal basis of spherical harmonics on Sn with n>=2 which achieves the maximal Lp norm growth. More precisely, one basis achieves this growth for all p =2(n+1)/(n-1). This extends the results in Han (arXiv:1404.5016) to all dimensions and all p>2, and improves the positive density subsequence there to a whole basis.
